requirementStats.text: Name, CIN, date and place of incorporation, registered and corporate office address
Main objects as set out in the Memorandum of Association
Particulars of the lead manager, registrar, market maker, banker to the issue and underwriter
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer details, investor grievance contact
Description of the business, products/services offered, and the revenue model
Industry overview and the issuer's competitive position within it
Customer concentration — identity of key customers and the revenue share attributable to each
Revenue from operations stated in the business section must reconcile with the restated audited financial statements
Installed capacity, capacity utilisation and principal properties/plants
Employee strength and human resources
Intellectual property owned or used by the issuer — trademarks, patents, designs and their registration status
Immovable properties owned or leased by the issuer, with tenure and the nature of the interest held
Narrative disclosures must be written in the impersonal, formal register of an offer document rather than in the first person
Company-specific (internal) risk factors derived from the issuer's own business and operations
Raw-material price volatility and supplier-concentration risk, where applicable
Customer-concentration risk where a small number of customers account for a large revenue share
Any outstanding litigation, tax demand or regulatory proceeding must be reflected as a risk factor
External, industry and issue-related risk factors, including risks relating to the SME platform and limited liquidity
Restated audited financial statements for the last three financial years (Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement)
Statement of accounting ratios — basic and diluted EPS, Return on Net Worth, Net Asset Value per share
Reference to the peer-reviewed statutory auditor, the auditor's firm registration number and the examination report on the restated financials
The revenue series presented in the financial statements must be internally consistent with the latest-year revenue relied upon elsewhere in the document
Capitalisation statement showing borrowings and shareholders' funds before and after the issue
Pre-issue and post-issue shareholding pattern and the history of the equity share capital build-up
Issue size, number of equity shares offered, face value and the basis of the price band
Objects of the issue with a break-up of the proposed utilisation of net proceeds and the schedule of deployment
The aggregate of the stated objects must reconcile with the net proceeds of the issue
Net proceeds must equal the gross issue size less the estimated issue-related expenses
Market maker reservation portion and the resulting net issue to the public
Appointment of a monitoring agency for the deployment of issue proceeds, where the issue size excluding the offer for sale exceeds INR 50 crore
Basis of the estimated working-capital requirement funded from the net proceeds, with the assumptions and holding periods relied upon
Amount proposed to be deployed towards general corporate purposes, which must not exceed fifteen per cent of the amount being raised or INR 10 crore, whichever is less
Break-up of the estimated issue-related expenses by category (fees of the lead manager, registrar, legal advisors, advertising, listing and statutory fees)
The objects of the issue must not include repayment, directly or indirectly, of any loan taken from a promoter, a member of the promoter group or any related party

Where the issue includes an offer for sale, that component must not exceed twenty per cent of the total issue size, and no selling shareholder may offer more than fifty per cent of their pre-issue holding on a fully diluted basis
Details of directors and key managerial personnel — name, designation, DIN, age, qualification and experience
Related-party transactions, including transactions with promoter-group entities, and the amounts involved
Outstanding litigation and material developments against the company, its directors, promoters and group companies
Group companies, their basic particulars and the nature of the relationship
Corporate governance — board composition, independent directors, and constitution of the Audit, Nomination & Remuneration and Stakeholders Relationship Committees
Remuneration paid to directors and key managerial personnel
Particulars of the issuer's subsidiaries, if any, with the nature of the holding and their financial position — or an express statement that the issuer has none
Cover page particulars — 'Draft Red Herring Prospectus' label, issue type (fixed price / book built), face value, price band, and the listing platform
Issuer's absolute responsibility statement and the lead manager's responsibility statement
General risk statement and the SME platform eligibility / listing statement
Definitions and abbreviations, including issue-related, company-related and industry terms
Presentation of financial, industry and market data — currency of presentation, financial year convention, rounding and the sourcing of third-party industry data
Forward-looking statements caution and the issuer's undertaking on material developments

Summary of the offer document — business, industry, promoters, issue size, objects, restated financials, litigation, related-party transactions and contingent liabilities, presented together at the front of the document
The Issue table — fresh issue and/or offer for sale, number of equity shares, face value and issue size
Issue structure — allocation between retail individual investors and other-than-retail investors, and the market maker portion
Terms of the issue — ranking of equity shares, mode of payment, rights of holders, minimum application size and lot
Issue procedure — ASBA and UPI mechanism, bidding process, basis of allotment and refund timelines
Underwriting and market making arrangements, including the underwriter's obligations
Qualitative factors supporting the issue price
Quantitative factors — basic and diluted EPS, price-to-earnings ratio at the price band, Return on Net Worth and Net Asset Value per share
Comparison with listed industry peers, or an express statement that no directly comparable listed peer exists
Key performance indicators of the issuer's business, disclosed for each restated period, certified and approved by the audit committee
Weighted average cost of acquisition of equity shares by the promoters and selling shareholders, compared against the issue price
Weighted average earnings per share and return on net worth across the restated periods, weighted by the respective period weights
Management's discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations, with year-on-year movement explained
Significant factors affecting the results of operations and any known trends or uncertainties
Financial indebtedness — secured and unsecured borrowings, principal lenders, security created and material terms
Government and other statutory approvals held and applied for, and approvals still required
Key regulations and policies applicable to the issuer's business
Other regulatory and statutory disclosures — SEBI disclaimer, exchange disclaimer, consents, expert opinions, previous public issues and listing particulars
Price information of past issues handled by the lead manager, and the lead manager's track record
Promoter particulars — name, age, qualification, experience, and shareholding in the issuer
Minimum promoter contribution and the lock-in applicable to promoter and pre-issue capital

Confirmation that the issuer, its promoters, promoter group, directors and selling shareholders are not debarred from accessing the capital markets, and that none is a wilful defaulter, a fraudulent borrower or a fugitive economic offender
Dividend policy and the dividend declared, if any, in the preceding financial years
Statement of special tax benefits available to the company and its shareholders, certified by the statutory auditor
Main provisions of the Articles of Association
Material contracts and documents available for inspection
Declaration by the directors and the Company Secretary confirming compliance with the Companies Act, the SEBI Act and the ICDR Regulations, and that no statement made is contrary to those provisions
Restrictions on foreign ownership of Indian securities under FEMA and the consolidated FDI policy
